audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart contradicted itself across layers and against the packet: full phases[0].side said 'Aatrox' while phases[0].why said 'Q-poke wins level 1 outright'; phases[2] said Gragas while whys[2] describes Aatrox winning level 3; phases[6] said Gragas while whys[6] describes an even/his-way late game.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill, Skill, Aatrox, Skill, Skill, Aatrox, Skill at 50.07% WR over 749 games. The content whys already describe level 3 and the first-item window as Aatrox's.
audit.corrected: Both layers aligned to the packet chart: Skill / Skill / Aatrox / Skill / Skill / Aatrox / Skill, with ratings 5,5,4,5,5,4,5 and the why-text adjusted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first-item phases claimed a clean Gragas spike with no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Explosive Cask is 100/85/70s; World Ender is 120/100/80s. At 6 both land, and the mirror audit already records that Cask knocks Aatrox out of his own Q pattern while World Ender's amp wins the extended brawl. That is an even level 6, not a Gragas one, and first item favours him unless Grievous Wounds is already bought.
audit.corrected: Level 6 reads as a mutual ult spike keyed to 100s vs 120s; first item reads as Aatrox-favoured pending Executioner's Calling.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood said 'E-slam only when his key tool is down' — no ability named, no number. dontsFull[1] was titled 'Stand in his Q sweetspots' but its body text was about burning an ultimate, an unrelated leftover.
audit.why: Aatrox's Umbral Dash (E) is 9/8/7/6/5s and is what repositions a Q sweetspot onto you or dodges your Body Slam; Body Slam (E) is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s. Aatrox's Q outer edge is the knock-up and, with Deathbringer Stance, his heal — the counterplay is lateral, since walking backwards stays inside the arc. Infernal Chains (W, 20s at rank 1) grounds and drags you back to centre, which is what actually punishes a whiffed Body Slam.
audit.corrected: tradeGood names Drunken Rage (5s) and Umbral Dash (9s at rank 1); dontsFull[1] body now states the outer-edge knock-up/heal and the sidestep direction.

audit.why: Packet flagged three suspect ability names — 'World Ender's', 'Use Explosive Cask', 'His Umbral Dash'. All three are the real Riot names in context; the flags are false positives from possessives and leading words.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright. Identify how Aatrox contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — one ability each, and his 3-cast Q is not assembled yet. Last-hit and sidestep the outer edge of his Q.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Aatrox must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His line-arc-slam Q sweetspots and Infernal Chains out-damage you at 3 while Body Slam sits on 14s — hold your engage back.

edits.before: Explosive Cask both finishes kills and deletes engages — you choose the fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Aatrox's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both ults land at 6: Explosive Cask (100s) knocks him off you, World Ender (120s) amplifies his healing. Whoever spends theirs second wins the trade.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on World Ender's cooldown.
edits.after: His first item plus World Ender healing beats one combo — get Executioner's Calling first.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Aatrox carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on it evens out: he out-sustains a pure 1v1, you out-value with Cask peel and engage — fight with your team, not alone.

edits.before: Q-poke Aatrox on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Q-poke from fog angles, Drunken Rage (5s) as he answers, and Body Slam only after Umbral Dash (9s) is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The outer edge knocks up and heals him — step sideways, not back.

edits.before: Your E-W-Q plus Explosive Cask all-in matches his cooldown window — you can stun-burst-and-Cask him off before his Deathbringer auto and dash heal flip it.
edits.after: Your E-W-Q plus Explosive Cask (100s) trades level with World Ender (120s) — stun-burst-and-Cask him off, or his Deathbringer auto and dash heal flip it.

notes: Level-chart flips proposed as one atomic group across both layers, aligned to packet.levelChart (Skill/Skill/Aatrox/Skill/Skill/Aatrox/Skill). All three packet suspectNames are false positives — World Ender, Explosive Cask and Umbral Dash are the correct Riot names. dontsFull[2].t ('Fight his R head-on') still carries a body about whiffing Body Slam; left alone because the text is accurate advice, but the pairing is loose.
